likelihood.h0_policy: fixed reference H0=70 km/s/Mpc; no H0 inference
likelihood.magnitude_offset: sampled explicitly with one proper uniform prior shared by all models
likelihood.normalization: full Gaussian normalization from logdet(precision) included

rationale.wa: Expanded below the historical -3 optimizer bound because the executed profile moved the optimum to about -6 and remained open toward lower wa. Evidence is prior-sensitive, so this wider bound is explicit rather than hidden.
rationale.M_offset: A proper shared finite prior is sampled rather than profiling an improper nuisance direction; this makes the model evidence mathematically defined.
rationale.RLL: Existing declared RLL parameter bounds are retained so the Bayes calculation measures the Occam penalty of the actual tested parameter volume rather than post-hoc shrinking around the optimum.

invariants: all models use the exact same Dovekie HD and precision matrix
all models sample the same proper magnitude-offset nuisance prior
no BIC proxy is accepted as logZ
CPL and RLL prior volumes are declared before execution
independent replication remains a separate gate
